simple.prompt: She ___ arrives at the office fifteen minutes before the official shift starts.
simple.explanation: 'Always' (100% frekuensi) diletakkan SEBELUM main verb 'arrives': 'She always arrives'.

simple.prompt: The senior manager is ___ punctual for all board meetings.
simple.explanation: Adverb of frequency diletakkan SETELAH to be (am/is/are/was/were): 'is always punctual'.
hints: Letakkan adverb of frequency setelah to be 'is'.
Pola: to be + adverb of frequency.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan adverb of frequency 'usually'.
simple.targetSentence: We usually have lunch at noon.
simple.explanation: Subject (We) + Adverb of frequency (usually) + Main verb (have) + Object + Time.

simple.prompt: I ___ drink caffeinated beverages after 6:00 p.m. because it disrupts my sleep.
simple.explanation: 'Never' (0% frekuensi) sudah bermakna negatif secara inheren, sehingga kata kerja tetap berbentuk positif tanpa 'not': 'I never drink'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan to be dan 'often'.
simple.targetSentence: They are often busy on Mondays.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + to be (are) + Adverb (often) + Adjective (busy) + on Mondays.

simple.prompt: He ___ checks his personal email during working hours.
simple.explanation: 'Rarely' (jarang/hampir tidak pernah: ~5-10%) diletakkan sebelum main verb: 'rarely checks'.

simple.targetSentence: She sometimes works from home on Fridays.
simple.explanation: Subject (She) + sometimes + works + from home on Fridays.
hints: Verb untuk orang ketiga tunggal adalah 'works'.

simple.prompt: Rafi ___ checks his calendar first thing every morning.
simple.explanation: Untuk kebiasaan rutin positif dengan main verb 'checks', letakkan 'always' tepat sebelum main verb.

simple.prompt: Our delivery courier is ___ late; he arrives promptly at nine every day.
simple.explanation: Berdasarkan konteks 'arrives promptly at nine every day', kurir tersebut tidak pernah terlambat ('never').
hints: Konteks kalimat kedua menunjukkan ketepatan waktu sempurna.

simple.prompt: Where should 'usually' go in this sentence with 'to be'?
options: The downtown branch is usually quiet on Tuesday mornings.
The downtown branch usually is quiet on Tuesday mornings.
Usually the downtown branch is quiet on Tuesday mornings?
simple.explanation: Dengan kata kerja to be ('is'), adverb of frequency diletakkan SESUDAH to be: 'is usually quiet'.
hints: Aturan dasar: verb biasa → sebelum verb; to be → sesudah to be.

simple.prompt: Do you ___ work from home on rainy Mondays?
simple.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya standar menanyakan seberapa sering, 'often' diletakkan setelah subjek ('you') dan sebelum main verb ('work').
hints: Pertanyaan 'Do you ... work?' menanyakan frekuensi kebiasaan positif.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang rutinitas olahraga pagi.
dialogue: Dina
How often does your team hold stand-up meetings?
Kino
We ___ meet three times a week via video call.
simple.explanation: Bertemu tiga kali seminggu menunjukkan rutinitas normal ('normally').
hints: Tiga kali seminggu adalah kebiasaan yang konsisten.
'Never' dan 'hardly ever' bertentangan dengan tiga kali seminggu.

simple.prompt: My cousin ___ eats spicy food because of his sensitive stomach.
simple.explanation: Karena perutnya sensitif, makna yang logis adalah jarang sekali memakan makanan pedas ('rarely').
hints: Lihat alasan 'because of his sensitive stomach'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda negatif dengan kata 'never' berikut.
simple.draft: Our security supervisor never skips not a single evening patrol.
options: Our security supervisor never skips a single evening patrol.
Our security supervisor skips never a single evening patrol.
Our security supervisor doesn't never skip a single evening patrol.
simple.explanation: 'Never' sudah membawa makna negatif sepenuhnya, sehingga tidak boleh dipasangkan dengan 'not' atau 'doesn't'.
hints: Hindari double negative dalam bahasa Inggris standar.

simple.prompt: She doesn't ___ drink espresso after five in the afternoon.
simple.explanation: Setelah 'doesn't', kata keterangan frekuensi seperti 'usually' atau 'often' mengikuti pola negatif wajar, hindari negatif ganda 'never/seldom'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kebiasaan dengan adverb sebelum kata kerja utama.
simple.targetSentence: My parents occasionally travel by overnight train.
simple.explanation: Adverb 'occasionally' diletakkan di antara subjek jamak 'My parents' dan verb 'travel'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat frekuensi memakai to be di tengah.
simple.targetSentence: The conference room microphone is rarely out of battery.
simple.explanation: Karena main verb adalah to be 'is', 'rarely' diletakkan tepat sesudah 'is'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The conference room microphone is'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dengan posisi adverb of frequency setelah modal auxiliary.
dialogue: New Intern
Where should I store the signed delivery receipts?
Office Manager
You must ___ file them in the green cabinet immediately.
intermediate.explanation: Bila terdapat modal auxiliary (must, can, should, will), adverb of frequency diletakkan DI ANTARA modal dan main verb: 'must always file'.
hints: Letakkan adverb di antara modal 'must' dan verb dasar 'file'.

intermediate.prompt: We have ___ experienced such unprecedented server instability in our cloud history.
intermediate.explanation: Pada tenses majemuk (Present Perfect: have + V3), adverb of frequency diletakkan setelah auxiliary pertama: 'have seldom experienced'. Kata baku adalah 'seldom', bukan *seldomly.

intermediate.prompt: Adverb of frequency 'sometimes' and 'occasionally' are flexible. They can be placed...
options: at the beginning, middle, or end of a clause
only at the very beginning of a sentence
only after the object of a sentence
intermediate.explanation: 'Sometimes' dan 'occasionally' sangat fleksibel: bisa di awal kalimat ('Sometimes we meet online'), di posisi tengah standar ('We sometimes meet'), maupun di akhir kalimat ('We meet online sometimes').
hints: Bisa di awal, tengah, maupun akhir.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan modal 'can' dan adverb 'usually'.
intermediate.targetSentence: You can usually reach him by phone.
intermediate.explanation: Subject (You) + modal (can) + adverb (usually) + base verb (reach) + him + by phone.
hints: Main verb adalah 'reach him by phone'.

intermediate.prompt: Negative frequency adverbs: 'hardly ever' means practically the same as...
Susun kalimat dengan frasa frekuensi 'hardly ever'.
intermediate.targetSentence: He hardly ever takes a sick day.
intermediate.explanation: Subject (He) + hardly ever + main verb (takes) + a sick day.

dialogue: Auditor
___ do you back up the customer database?
System Admin
We back it up automatically twice every day.
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan untuk menanyakan frekuensi keteraturan rutinitas adalah 'How often'.

intermediate.prompt: The maintenance team can ___ resolve minor network glitches within ten minutes.
intermediate.explanation: Saat kalimat memakai modal atau auxiliary verb ('can', 'will', 'have'), adverb of frequency diletakkan DI ANTARA auxiliary dan main verb: 'can usually resolve'.

intermediate.prompt: I have ___ missed an international flight in twelve years of consulting work.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam Present Perfect ('have + V3'), adverb of frequency diletakkan di antara 'have/has' dan past participle ('have never missed').
hints: Struktur Present Perfect memisahkan 'have' dan V3 'missed'.
Pilih 'never' sebagai makna belum pernah terjadi.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang rapat mengenai kebiasaan pengecekan berkala.
dialogue: Manager
Does the backup script run overnight?
Dev
Yes, it runs ___, right after midnight.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa penjelas frekuensi spesifik ('every single night', 'twice a day') diletakkan di posisi akhir kalimat (bukan di antara subjek dan verb).
hints: Perhatikan posisi rumpang di akhir klausa.
Frasa multi-kata seperti 'every single night' cocok di belakang.

intermediate.prompt: She ___ attends optional Friday workshops, though she prefers independent reading.
intermediate.explanation: 'Sometimes' menempati posisi tengah sebelum verb 'attends' (juga fleksibel diletakkan di awal atau akhir kalimat).
hints: Hindari bentuk negatif ganda pada pengecoh.

intermediate.prompt: We ___ ever receive complaints about our packaging durability.
intermediate.explanation: Ungkapan tetap 'hardly ever' berarti 'hampir tidak pernah' dan bersifat negatif tanpa perlu 'not'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penempatan adverb frekuensi pada kalimat ber-auxiliary berikut.
intermediate.draft: Our regional suppliers have always been reliable, yet they will delay occasionally deliveries.
options: Our regional suppliers have always been reliable, yet they will occasionally delay deliveries.
Our regional suppliers always have been reliable, yet they occasionally will delay deliveries.
Our regional suppliers have been always reliable, yet they will delay deliveries occasionally?
intermediate.explanation: Pada klausa kedua yang memakai modal 'will' + verb 'delay', letakkan 'occasionally' di antara modal dan verb utama: 'will occasionally delay'.
hints: Adverb frekuensi di antara auxiliary 'will' dan main verb 'delay'.

intermediate.prompt: Have you ___ visited the maritime museum near the old port?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya pengalaman ('Have you...?'), gunakan 'ever' di antara subjek 'you' dan verb V3 'visited'.

intermediate.prompt: How ___ do your quarterly steering committee meetings take place?
intermediate.explanation: Frasa tanya baku untuk menanyakan frekuensi adalah 'How often...?'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai dua auxiliary sebelum verb utama.
intermediate.targetSentence: That legacy script has always been maintained by the senior architect.
intermediate.explanation: Jika ada dua auxiliary ('has' + 'been'), adverb frekuensi umumnya diletakkan setelah auxiliary PERTAMA ('has always been').
hints: Awali dengan 'That legacy script has always'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'been maintained by the senior architect'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat menggunakan frasa waktu spesifik di akhir.
intermediate.targetSentence: Our editorial desk publishes a printed digest twice a month.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa frekuensi berpola jumlah ('twice a month', 'every two weeks') diletakkan di akhir kalimat.
hints: Awali dengan subjek dan verb 'Our editorial desk publishes'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan 'double negative' dengan adverb of frequency negatif.
complex.draft: Our organization doesn't hardly ever outsource core software engineering.
options: Our organization hardly ever outsources core software engineering.
Our organization doesn't rarely outsource core software engineering.
Our organization hardly never outsources core software engineering.
complex.explanation: 'Hardly ever', 'rarely', 'seldom', dan 'scarcely' sudah bermakna negatif secara inheren. Menggabungkannya dengan 'doesn't' atau 'not' menghasilkan double negative yang salah secara gramatikal.

complex.prompt: Inversion formal gaya sastra/akademis: 'Seldom ___ such an inspiring innovation showcase.'
complex.explanation: Ketika negative/restrictive frequency adverb (Seldom, Rarely, Never, Scarcely) diletakkan di AWAL kalimat untuk penekanan dramatis (inversion), kata kerja mengalami inversi bentuk tanya (Auxiliary + Subject): 'Seldom have we witnessed...'.
hints: Negative adverb di awal kalimat memicu inversi kalimat tanya.

complex.prompt: Inversi dengan 'Never before': 'Never before ___ such high customer satisfaction ratings.'
complex.explanation: Inversi: Never before + auxiliary (has) + subject (the firm) + V3 (achieved).
hints: 'Never before' di awal kalimat memicu inversi.

complex.targetSentence: Rarely does such an opportunity present itself.
complex.explanation: Negative adverb (Rarely) + auxiliary (does) + subject (such an opportunity) + base verb (present itself).

complex.prompt: Koreksi posisi adverb of frequency pada kalimat dengan dua auxiliary verb.
complex.draft: The software has been always tested before every release.
options: The software has always been tested before every release.
The software always has been tested before every release.
The software has been tested always before every release.
complex.explanation: Bila kalimat memiliki lebih dari satu kata kerja bantu (has been tested), adverb of frequency diletakkan TEPAT SETELAH AUXILIARY PERTAMA: 'has ALWAYS been tested'.
hints: Letakkan adverb tepat setelah auxiliary pertama ('has').

complex.prompt: Inversion dengan 'Hardly': 'Hardly ever ___ to complain about the rigorous workload.'
complex.explanation: Inversi masa lampau: Hardly ever + did + she + pause.

dialogue: Prosecutor
Has the defendant demonstrated genuine remorse?
Judge
Scarcely ever ___ any acknowledgment of wrongdoing.
complex.explanation: Scarcely ever + auxiliary (has) + subject (he) + past participle (shown).

complex.prompt: Seldom ___ such cohesive teamwork during an emergency server migration.
complex.explanation: Adverb frekuensi negatif/restriktif ('Seldom', 'Rarely', 'Never', 'Hardly ever') di awal kalimat formal wajib memicu INVERSI (Auxiliary + Subject + Main Verb).
hints: Perhatikan adverb negatif 'Seldom' berdiri di awal kalimat.

complex.prompt: Hardly ever ___ willing to revise terms after signing a final agreement.
complex.explanation: 'Hardly ever' di awal kalimat diikuti to be 'are' sebelum subjek jamak 'commercial banks' ('Hardly ever are commercial banks...').
hints: Inversi to be menukar 'are' ke depan subjek.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan struktur inversi setelah adverb negatif 'Never' di awal kalimat berikut.
complex.draft: Never the audit board has approved an expense without supporting receipts.
options: Never has the audit board approved an expense without supporting receipts.
Never did the audit board approved an expense without supporting receipts.
Never the audit board approved has an expense without supporting receipts.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'Never' di posisi paling depan kalimat formal, auxiliary 'has' wajib berpindah ke depan subjek 'the audit board'.
hints: 'Never' di awal kalimat menuntut inversi auxiliary + subjek.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan penekanan khusus dengan adverb sebelum to be (kasus emfatis/elipsis).
dialogue: Lead
Does your analyst check the logs?
Partner
Check them? Oh, he certainly does — in fact, he ALWAYS ___ when alerts fire!
complex.explanation: Penekanan vokal pada modal/to be atau bentuk emfatis tidak memindahkan verb secara acak; 'he ALWAYS is watching' atau bentuk lengkap dengan auxiliary berstres menempatkan 'always' sebelum auxiliary ketika seluruh auxiliary ditekan untuk penegasan emfatis.
hints: Cari bentuk kalimat yang tetap gramatikal dan sesuai konteks aktif.
'Watches always' dan 'never is' melanggar urutan atau makna.

complex.prompt: Not only does the team review bugs weekly, but rarely ___ an unpatched release reach production.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'rarely' di klausa kedua, inversi Present Simple dengan subjek tunggal 'an unpatched release' dan verb dasar 'reach' membutuhkan auxiliary 'does'.
hints: Perhatikan main verb dasar 'reach' di akhir kalimat.

complex.prompt: In formal academic writing, 'now and then' or 'every once in a while' is best replaced by the single-word adverb ___.
complex.explanation: 'Periodically' atau 'occasionally' menyampaikan frekuensi berkala secara ringkas dan tepat dalam ragam tulis formal.
hints: Pilih kata keterangan resmi yang benar ejaannya.
'Alwaysly' dan 'hardly never' tidak ada dalam bahasa Inggris baku.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum posisi adverb frekuensi dalam kalimat elipsis jawaban singkat berikut.
complex.draft: Are the regional managers attending on time? — Yes, they are always.
options: Are the regional managers attending on time? — Yes, they always are.
Are the regional managers attending on time? — Yes, always they are.
Are the regional managers attending on time? — Yes, they are always doing.
complex.explanation: Saat kalimat berakhir dengan to be atau auxiliary singkat tanpa pelengkap (elipsis/short response), adverb of frequency berpindah ke DEPAN to be/auxiliary: 'Yes, they always are.'
hints: Di ujung kalimat pendek tanpa objek/pelengkap, to be TIDAK diletakkan sebelum 'always'.

complex.prompt: Compare carefully: 'Usually, I don't work past seven' vs 'I don't usually work past seven' — the second sentence means...
options: it is not my habit to work past seven
I refuse every time without exception
I am always working past seven
complex.explanation: 'Don't usually' meniadakan kebiasaan secara wajar ('biasanya tidak bekerja lewat jam tujuh'), lebih lunak daripada 'never'.

complex.targetSentence: Rarely have we observed such rapid adoption across rural clinics.
complex.explanation: 'Rarely' di awal kalimat memicu inversi Present Perfect: 'Rarely + have + we + observed...'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat elipsis penutup dengan adverb frekuensi sebelum auxiliary.
complex.targetSentence: She promises to submit reports early, and she almost always does.
complex.explanation: Karena 'does' berdiri sebagai auxiliary pengganti di akhir kalimat, 'almost always' ditempatkan SEBELUM 'does'.
hints: Awali dengan 'She promises to submit reports early,'.
Akhiri dengan 'and she almost always does'.
